I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`. It gives the expected output for Example 1 under `wj run --interpret`, and `wj build main.wj` succeeds. I didn't run Example 2 or any other input.

It keeps the keys and values in two parallel lists, most recently used first. A `put` or successful `get` moves the key to the front. When a `put` takes the cache over capacity, the last key is removed and printed as
